title: Main effect 'Move an enemy unit to a battlefield where you have units' resolves to a non-existent zone
expected: Reproduced. ven-148-166 (Shadow Dash) has `abilities:[null]` in packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json:4323 and is runtime-parsed (all-cards.ts getAllCards) to `{type:"move", target:{type:"unit",controller:"enemy"}, to:"battlefield"}` — no "where you have units" filter, no destination choice, and the "+1 Might if exactly two units" rider is dropped. In packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/move.ts:530-541, a string `to` that isn't "chosen-battlefield"/"target-battlefield"/"choose"/"same"/"here" is used verbatim as the zone id (`targetZone = dest` → moveCardWithEvent(ctx, id, "battlefield")), and core zones.moveCard throws `Target zone battlefield does not exist` (packages/core/src/operations/operations-impl.ts:225). Harness repro: P1 casts Shadow Dash targeting an enemy unit at bf2, P1 passes, P2 pass → `passChainPriority rejected: Target zone battlefield does not exist`; spell stays stuck on chain, foe never moves.
observed: Parsed effect is {type:'move', target:{unit,enemy}, to:'battlefield'} (literal string, no 'where you have units' filter, no destination choice). When both players pass, resolution fails with {error:'Target zone battlefield does not exist', errorCode:'EXECUTION_ERROR'} (seen on REST passChainPriority for player-2; goldfish auto-pass silently fails the same way).
